hints.title: One value per level
hints.body: The right view contains exactly the last node visited at each depth in a left-to-right level traversal.

hints.title: Level order
hints.body: Process one level at a time and record its final node.

hints.title: Right-first DFS
hints.body: Alternatively, visit right children before left and record the first node seen at each new depth.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
if root is null: return []
result = []
current = [root]
while current is not empty:
    result.append(value of last node in current)
    nextLevel = []
    for node in current:
        if node.left: append left
        if node.right: append right
    current = nextLevel
return result
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
